code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, INR, and basophils, as well as low total protein. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and hypoxic stress, which may be seen in severe infection (e.g., COVID-19), sepsis, or other critical illness. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are strongly recommended.
